content:
I think you might want to change the variable name of [[i]] because it gets used in the for loop as well.

Also, the goal should probably say '<<add>> the index value to [[sum]].' instead of 'from'.
Is it supposed to say 'if a letter has an even index' or is it referring to the [[i]] variable index?

I had to look at your solution to figure out, no way I would have guessed that the index you were referring to was the letter's original 0-based alphabetical index. Other than that, seems like a good puzzle.
